text:
maia: Heads-up: emerald-ptq-v2 started emitting malformed JSON for toolhook calls on the canary. Seeing this intermittently during streaming with long contexts. Example below (raw chunk):

maia: ```json
{"action": "open_ticket", "params": {"summary": "Deploy failed", "labels": ["infra", }
```

oliver: yikes. did this start right after the PTQ build or after the kvcache/streaming tweak? :eyes:

maia: correlated with the PTQ build + streaming kvcache enabled. repro: long prompt + token_limit 2048. I can attach full raw stream logs.

shreya: can you paste the exact stream chunk boundary? maybe it's a mid-token/utf8 split or the model emitted a trailing comma across chunks. :thinking_face:

maia: raw stream pieces looked like this:
```
..."params": {"summary": "Deploy failed", "labels": ["infra", "urgent"]

, "extra": "note" }
```
which becomes invalid when concatenated because of the leading comma in the second chunk.

vik: does our stitcher attempt to normalize across chunk boundaries? we have the "json-wait-for-close" heuristic — could be tripping.

maia: yeah the stitcher waits for a closing brace and tries a quick repair by dropping leading/trailing commas, but PTQ outputs sometimes put punctuation inside a split so repair logic misfires.

oliver: ok can we add a lenient repair pass (json5-like) before doing a full retry/regeneration? cheaper and might cut false negatives.

maia: tested a json5-style repair locally, healed ~70% of the cases. caveat: in some healed outputs the semantic structure changed (e.g., arrays merged), so we need to flag repaired responses in telemetry and not auto-accept for critical routes.

shreya: I'll add a high-sample raw-stream capture on the canary to collect: model_variant, quant config, kvcache on/off, prompt length, and token boundary snapshots. @maia share the canary id and I'll wire up the sampler.

maia: canary id: emerald-ptq-v2-2026-03-20. repro snippet (playground):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"emerald-ptq-v2","stream":true,"kvcache":true,"max_tokens":2048,"prompt":"<long prompt>"}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary profile emerald-ptq-v2-2026-03-20 rolled back to emerald-ptq-v1 at 5801234575 to maintain stability.

maia: thanks — I'll run a matrix of kvcache on/off x streaming on/off x quant-opset variations and post results tomorrow.

vik: cc platform-team: we should consider quarantining PTQ variants until we harden the streaming stitcher heuristics and add a non-destructive repair flag in the router.
